title: 17911 - 17911/P1503
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or connections faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  / Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Voltage Regulator

Kontrol edin:  the fuse box that is in the battery tray, it might be burnt, the fuse or the complete plastic box (pretty common failure on Sharan because it carries so much electrical load). If so, change the complete fuse box, it is not too expensive fix if this is the cause.
technicalNotes: When found on the BEW engine, check MVB 16, Field 1.  In most cases values will be between 15% to 30% at idle.  0% could indicate a failed or incorrect alternator.
